name: devdeck
description: DevDeck: cockpit local do dev — vibe coding com Claude Agent SDK, MCPs, diff com aprovação, custos, perfil com métricas git e conquistas, agenda e comunidade.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:test
scripts.dist:win: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-fuses.mjs
scripts.pack:win: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never && node scripts/verify-fuses.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/fake-api.smoke.mjs && electron-vite build && node tests/e2e/git-trust.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/approval.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/theme.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/auth-error.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/notifications.e2e.mjs
